fields.name: blue_deposited
fields.description: Integer number of blue cubes successfully released into the bin by this decision step. Start at zero; increment at the first decision step following each completed blue-cube deposit, not at pickup or when issuing B. Preserve otherwise. Episode 8 values are 0,0,1,1,2; episode 60 values are 0,0,1,1,2,2,3; all other supplied episodes remain zero. e.g. 1
